director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket-ground jaise shapes ka perimeter, yani boundary length, dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Riya, socho cricket pitch ke chaaron taraf rope lagani ho—tum total rope kaise pata karogi? Baad mein ye Golu ko sikhaogi.
Bilkul Riya, tareeka badalte hain: perimeter ko picture, chhoti story, ya quick game se dekhein—tum kaunsa choose karogi?
Riya, perimeter ka matlab boundary ke sabhi sides ko jodna hai. Cricket ground ki boundary ke liye sides ginogi ya area?
Riya, area andar ki jagah hota hai; boundary ke chaaron taraf ki lambai perimeter. Ab rectangle ka perimeter nikaalte hain.
Riya, game rule: shape ki har side ko ek baar count karo; pehli side ka number bolo.
Game ne 3 ko pehli side maana. Ab uske saamne wali side par move karke number bolo.
Riya, tum keh rahi ho ye boring hai—chalo tareeka badlein: picture puzzle, cricket story, ya speed game. Tum ek choose karke bolo.
